slug: 2025-10-24 Benin unveils platform to ease biometric passport applications for diaspora citizens

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Benin's ePass app lets citizens abroad register with their national digital ID and consular number and submit fingerprint and face biometrics for subsequent authentication.

BEN.note: No civil register link is mentioned.
No count or share of people holding the ID is given.
Nothing on who operates or maintains the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: Biometric Update says teams were dispatched abroad in 2023 to issue digital IDs to Beninese living abroad, and ePass registration uses the national digital ID.
